behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.InspectBeforeFromFirstEligiblePosition) decides only where an operand's BEFORE delimiter is looked for when it also has AFTER; at 2002 the BEFORE portion runs from the leftmost position (§2002:14.8.21.3 GR8b) and the operand participates where it meets the AFTER portion (§2002:14.8.21.3 GR8). Item identification happens before any region is computed and the switch does not move it; the read's evidence (pb5184, pb4115, pb1123 at 2002) stands. pb5120_before_after_intersection, run at --std 2002 this session: output MATCHes its 2002 .out (CROSSED 00, REPLACED AYAAXAA, CONVERTED AYAAXAA, CHARACTERS 00), the 2002 leftmost rule on formats 1, 2 and 4.
